mods.name: Script Hook V
mods.author: Alexander Blade
mods.notes: The base every script mod runs on: lets the game load .asi plugins and scripts. Copies ScriptHookV.dll and xinput1_4.dll from the zip's bin folder. xinput1_4.dll is the .asi loader GTA V Enhanced uses; dinput8.dll in the same folder is the Legacy loader and is not copied; NativeTrainer.asi is skipped on purpose (Menyoo is the trainer); args.txt is not copied (it switches BattlEye off; turn BattlEye off in the Rockstar Games Launcher yourself, as Menyoo's page asks). Sources: the GTA VI-Inspired HUD's Enhanced guide, Step 2 (bin folder: ScriptHookV.dll, xinput1_4.dll 'loads mods ending in .asi on Enhanced', args.txt, dinput8.dll 'the mod loader for Legacy. Enhanced doesn't use it') and its changelog ('On GTA V Enhanced, Script Hook V's xinput1_4.dll is what loads .asi mods; dinput8.dll is the Legacy loader'). dev-c.com's own install text still only names dinput8.dll (written for Legacy). NaturalVision Enhanced's Main Package brings its own xinput1_4.dll and replaces this one later (same loader, per the same guide); Leonida backs up Script Hook V's copy, so rolling NVE back restores it. Game builds: the readme of v3889.0/1158.13 lists Enhanced 1.0.811.8, 812.8, 813.11, 814.9, 889.15/19/22, 1013.17/29/33/34 and 1158.13; dev-c.com only offers this newest release. 1.0.1013.20 isn't listed (its changelog entry v3725.0/1013.20 is only 'control natives compatibility'), but it works: tested on the owner's PC on 2026-11-24 (GTA5_Enhanced.exe 1.0.1013.20), ScriptHookV.log said 'INIT: Success, game version is VER_EN_1_0_1013_17' and registered Menyoo.asi and ScriptHookVDotNet.asi. Script Hook V treats 1013.20 as 1013.17. On another build, check ScriptHookV.log the same way ('unknown game version' = not supported). In game: The script mods below work at all (the HUD shows, F8 opens Menyoo). ScriptHookV.log in the game folder says 'INIT: Success, game version is ...'.

mods.notes: Runs the .NET script mods (the GTA VI HUD, Enable All Interiors and more); F4 opens its console. Game builds: one build for Legacy and all Enhanced builds (README). Its page gives no value.

mods.name: Resource Extensions [Enhanced]
mods.author: Koukol
mods.notes: Raises the game's memory and object limits so big map and car mods load without crashing. Never run old heap/packfile/modkit adjusters or a custom gameconfig.xml with this. Keep density 1.00-2.00 in the .ini. Game builds: the page names no minimum build. 2.1 was 'updated for 1.0.1158.16'; since 2.4 'feature groups are checked separately, allowing compatible features to remain active when others are unsupported', so on older builds some limits may stay vanilla ('Partially Active'). Turn on ResourceExtensions.log in the .ini to see what is active on your build. Only 2.4 and 2.5 are listed under 'All Versions'. Also in INTER's 'I Made GTA 5 Closest To GTA 6..' (youtu.be/OIpIGtGsk3Q, 13 Nov 2026, made on GTA 5 Enhanced); checked against the manifest on 2026-11-25. In game: Streets and parking lots are fuller on Balanced / Ultra than on Performance. ResourceExtensions.log lists its features as Active (or Partially Active). Older builds (checked 2026-11-25): the owner's ResourceExtensions.log (RE 2.5, game build 1.0.1013.20, 2026-11-25): 'Packfile Limit: Inactive', 'Engine Pools: Inactive', 'Model Slots: Inactive', 'Pool Memory Budget: Inactive', 'Population Density (INI): Inactive' (with AmbientPeds=1.50 set), 'Audio Heap: Inactive', 'Gameconfig Pool Overrides: Partially Active'; Main Heap, Resource Arena, Asset Stores and Graphics Resource Budgets Active. Leonida's answer is in its gameBuilds entry: raise-only gameconfig.xml pools from the HUD and GTA V Remastered, no density keys. Resource Extensions' readme on StreamingMemoryBudget: 'Set to 1 only if your mods need higher budgets'; on VehicleModelBudget: increase gradually.

mods.notes: Fixes hundreds of small map bugs: missing walls, floating props, broken collisions and textures. Game builds: the page offers only the newest version (21.8.2 Enhanced, Nov 2026) and states no game build. Its .oiv edits files in update.rpf, which can change between game builds: unconfirmed on 1.0.1013.20. Sources for the onigiri folder layout: the Onigiri page on Nexus (gta5enhanced/mods/688): onigiri\common = update\update.rpf\common, onigiri\platform = update\update.rpf\x64, onigiri\dlcpacks = update\x64\dlcpacks, not compatible with OpenRPF; the same layout in sruckstar's ModDrop V README; and the GTA VI-Inspired HUD's Enhanced guide (NVE section). Checked against the real download on 2026-11-24: the file downloaded first (5e056b-MapFixes_v21.8.2_NG.rar, 531 MB) was the Legacy package (Legacy/spmapfixes/dlc.rpf, Legacy/MP Map Fixes Pack 1.oiv and Pack 2.oiv). Its ReadMe.txt names the Enhanced parts: the spMapFixes_Gen9 folder and 'MP Map Fixes.oiv'. The Legacy .oivs change files inside nested map archives (e.g. update.rpf\dlc_patch\mpheist\x64\levels\gta5\...\*.rpf), so under NVE whole .rpf files have to be extracted; the Enhanced list is below. Enhanced file checked 2026-11-24: '383134-MapFixes_v21.8.2_Gen9.rar' (530 MB) = Enhanced\spMapFixes_Gen9\dlc.rpf (507,451,904 bytes), Enhanced\MP Map Fixes.oiv (50.9 MB), ReadMe/Changes/Credits.txt. ReadMe 'Installation (Enhanced)': spMapFixes_Gen9 into mods\update\x64\dlcpacks, <Item>dlcpacks:/spMapFixes_Gen9/</Item>, install 'MP Map Fixes.oiv'; requirements (Enhanced): latest CodeWalker (Discord build), RageOpenV or OpenRPF, OIV Package Installer, Resource Extensions, Bugstar Fixes. The .oiv's assembly.xml has 577 file adds: 392 inside update.rpf (dlc_patch\mpapartment, mpheist, mplowrider map .rpfs) and 185 inside update\x64\dlcpacks\<pack>\dlc*.rpf (mpHeist 121, mpApartment 18, mpLowrider 18, mpbiker 17, mpGunrunning 2, mpSecurity 2, mpHeist4 2, mpBattle, mpChristmas2017, mpHeist3, mpVinewood, mp2025_02 1 each); nothing outside the update folder. Its newest target pack, mp2025_02, exists on the owner's 1.0.1013.20 (read 2026-11-24). Fits 1.0.1013.20: spMapFixes_Gen9 has no dependency and no 2026 names; the page keeps only 21.8.2. In game: Hundreds of small map fixes: mostly you notice nothing broken. Spot check: the volleyball nets on Vespucci Beach have matching collisions, and the beach huts there look right from a distance.

steps: Download the file marked '21.8.2 Enhanced' under 'All Versions' on the page (its file name ends in '_Gen9.rar').
